module.purpose: Provides localStorage persistence for collections with cross-tab synchronization and SSR fallback support. Exports localStorageCollectionOptions to create collections that automatically sync to localStorage and other browser tabs.
module.summary: This module implements a localStorage-backed collection system that persists data to browser storage with automatic synchronization across browser tabs via storage events. It provides a fallback to in-memory storage for server-side rendering environments. The main export is localStorageCollectionOptions which creates collection configurations with utilities for clearing storage, getting storage size, and accepting mutations from transactions. Key features include version tracking for change detection, JSON serialization validation, key encoding to prevent collisions between numeric and string keys, and a sync system that loads initial data and listens for cross-tab changes.
module.businessContext: Enables client-side data persistence for web applications using IndexedDB-style collections. Critical for offline functionality and data synchronization. Failure breaks local data persistence and cross-tab sync in browser environments.
